title: Rebekah: bethulah (virgin) in Genesis 24:16 and almah (maiden) in 24:43
summary: Compares two Hebrew words used for Rebekah in Genesis 24: bethulah (בתולה, virgin) in verse 16 and almah (עלמה, maiden) in verse 43, showing both verses in English and Hebrew with the key words in green.

text.text: 16 The girl [Rebekah] was very beautiful, a virgin, and no man had had relations with her; and she went down to the spring and filled her jar and came up.
43 behold, I am standing by the spring, and may it be that the maiden who comes out to draw, and to whom I say, "Please let me drink a little water from your jar;"
הנה אנכי נצב על-עין המים והיה העלמה היצאת לשאב ...

words.gloss: maiden, young woman of marriageable age

uncertain: Hebrew reference for verse 16 is written כד:יו on the slide (standard form would be כד:טז)
